Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for YSP University Nauni Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in date for the Guest Faculty positions at YSP University Nauni?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty positions at YSP University Nauni is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. How many Guest Faculty posts are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 Guest Faculty posts advertised by YSP University Nauni. These include positions in Entomology, Computer Science, and Food Science & Technology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the job type for these Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty positions at YSP University Nauni are contractual in nature. This means the employment is for a fixed period as per the university's requirements.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the YSP University Nauni office. The specific address and reporting time will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and self-attested photocopies of these documents.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for these Guest Faculty positions. Candidates are advised to confirm this in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty posts at YSP University Nauni will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Performance in the interview will be the primary basis for selection.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is UHF/COH&F/TNG/Estt/4-32/2026/-8333-38. This number should be referenced when inquiring about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of YSP University Nauni?
faq.answer: The official website of Dr. Yashwant Singh Parmar University of Horticulture & Forestry (YSP University Nauni) is the primary source for all official information. You can find the link in the 'Important Links' section.
